conditions.notes: OBS-0007 is the origin-side confirmation that OBS-0006's reopening condition asked for: OBS-HUM-0001 confirms both transit differences and attributes them — the dropped independence clause to accident (channel noise, unnoticed by the sender), the added co-signature to deliberate choice. This meets OBS-0006's reopening condition ('an expression from OBS-HUM-0001 confirming or correcting the intent of the modifications') while the elements were still candidates, before any acceptance. The confirmation refines rather than closes OBS-0006: the channel's transformation is now decomposed into theta (deliberate) and epsilon (accidental) components, mirroring the field's own observer model y = pi(x; theta) + epsilon. Same shape as REL-0036 (a human expression confirming an AI observation from a different observer class), but arriving pre-acceptance rather than post-acceptance — the first confirmation in the field's history to do so.
